output.methodChoice: Combination of C and D: compare IS/IS NOT cells across press, supplier and shift, and test the four hypotheses against the cells they cannot explain.
output.brief: The rejects come from the combination of Arnholt resin and Press 5's degraded dryer (D5). Neither alone causes them. On Press 5, Arnholt runs about 10% rejects on both shifts. Press 5 on Quillan runs 0.9%. Press 7 on Arnholt runs 0.8%. The new operators match the experienced ones on each resin, so they are not the cause. Please don't discipline them. Arnholt arrives wetter at the dryer (0.27–0.33% against 0.11–0.14%). D5 can't dry it to the 0.20% limit. A healthy dryer (D7) can. The same Arnholt lot gave 10.4% rejects through D5 and 0.8% through a portable dryer at −40 °C. Do not drop Arnholt. Next steps: repair D5 (heater and desiccant), confirm −40 °C, and restore the original alarm limit. Until then, keep Arnholt off D5 and add a moisture check at the press throat for every resin lot. Arnholt was sampled only from the north annex, so I can't say how much storage adds to its moisture. Treat the annex as a separate question. Moving the octabins to rented space is premature. Running Arnholt only on Press 7 and leaving D5 broken would be an incomplete fix.
